name: Balances
overview: Scripture emphasizes the importance of just and accurate balances as a reflection of God's character and justice. Honest weights and balances are commanded, symbolizing integrity in commerce and life, as seen in Leviticus 19:36 and Proverbs 16:11. Conversely, false balances, deceitful weights, and diverse measures are described as abominations to the LORD, highlighting the severity of dishonesty (Proverbs 11:1; 20:23). Figuratively, balances also represent God's perfect knowledge and judgment, as expressed in Job 31:6 and Isaiah 40:12.
